## `getJWTTokenByAccessToken`

**GET** `/api/jwt/{JwtAppName}/token`

Retrieve JWT token by Access Token

Retrieves a JWT token using an Access Token obtained after successful login.

### Example

```typescript
async function callGetJWTTokenByAccessToken(client: LoginRadius) {
  const JwtAppName: string = '<JwtAppName>'; //Required
  const Nonce: string = '<Nonce>'; //Optional

  try {
    const res = await client.<service>.getJWTTokenByAccessToken({ JwtAppName, Nonce });
    console.log(res.data);
  } catch (err) {
    if (err instanceof LoginRadiusError) {
      console.error(err.description);
    } else {
      throw err;
    }
  }
}
```

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `JwtAppName` | path | string | yes | JWT App Name |
| `Nonce` | query | string | no | random nonce claim |

### Returns
